text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes, the Fillies' Revue!
One of the main prep races for the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Lately, no one who went through here has won the Oka Sho, but... this year's the year!
That's why the Fillies' Revue is a must-watch!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're blabbering on and on to yourself, but...
How's this year's lineup, honestly?
I haven't really looked into it, though...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You... idiot! Go do your research properly!
There's one super crazy girl this year!
Her name is—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Rhein Kraft-san!
Please, give us an interview!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
Th-There are so many cameras...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Following the Hanshin JF, you have overwhelming expectations riding on you!
Would you please say a few words for your fans?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: U-Um...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The Fillies' Revue is a race that even that Triple Tiara Umamusume, Mejiro Ramonu-san, won...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my absolute best, true to who I am!!
Please cheer me on!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"Craft-san!" "Look over here!"
"What's the main focus for today's race—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —So, you're saying nobody's coming over this way?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please...
It makes me wonder if you were really even
paying attention during the Hanshin JF!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I really... can't believe it.
Yeah, really... I can't believe it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how unusual!
I rarely see you with such a stern look on your face.
choice_data_list: Because you're an Umamusume worthy of praise.
Because you are an Umamusume worthy of praise.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks, I feel the exact same way!
I don't think I'm inferior to anyone.
Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Craft's brilliance shines far brighter than my own...
That's all there is to it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Unless you give it more than everything you've got today, it's going to be tough.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There's still another girl
we can't afford to let our guard down around—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Messiah.
...You look like you're in good shape, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was able to get myself
in prime condition just in time for today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! Now I'm looking forward to
competing against you even more!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Looking forward to it, are you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"You and Craft-san are like that, aren't you?
You run with very different motivations from mine."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably... I may never be able to
enjoy it with that same warmth.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Because my victory does not belong to me alone.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...You mean your mother, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My mother's greatness—her strength.
I shall prove it through my victory as the heir to her bloodline.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, Miss Heart.
I will not yield—the joy of victory.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Did you see Messiah's eyes?
They were blazing—burning to prove what she believes in.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Facing Craft made me feel purely...
like a true challenger, deep down."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
However, today's match
will be a clash of convictions...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume competing with all sorts of motivations...
Racing really is fascinating, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Right?
Well then, shall we get going?"
Just then—I remembered how her friends had entrusted me with their cheers on New Year's Day. So, copying what they did as best I could—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks!
I'll go put up a good fight!"
